slices.focus: Projector movie night becomes an effective decompression routine.
slices.summary: Min-seo borrows a projector from a coworker; they have a quiet dinner and watch a realistic maritime film on the apartment wall. Jae-hyun realizes the ritual (dinner at home, dim lights, one familiar film, phone away) decompresses him far better than doom-scrolling port clips. He plans to borrow the projector again and build a short rewatch list rather than buying gear prematurely.
decisions: Jae-hyun has started deliberately using quiet home movie nights as a post-shift decompression routine, especially by rew
